title: Choose by a pattern
summary: Elixir: Choose by a pattern. Try result = :error.
introduction: case matches a value against patterns. _ is a catch-all pattern.
learningObjectives: Choose by a pattern with Elixir

blocks.text: Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.

blocks.title: Choose by a pattern
blocks.code:
result = {:ok, 8}
message = case result do
 {:ok, n} -> "Score: #{n}"
 _ -> "Try again"
end
IO.puts(message)

blocks.text: The ok tuple matches and binds n to 8. That value is inserted into the message.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Include a case for the shapes your program can receive.
